task_definition.task_description: Please check whether flight AA100 is on time, then book it for Alex Johnson in economy. After that, get the stay details for Hilton Tokyo and archive them, find a travel-accessory recommendation related to the Sony XM5 item, choose a suitable alternative, place 1 unit on hold, confirm the order, build it into cart items, generate an invoice with the SAVE15 coupon sent to alex@example.com via PayPal, then also retrieve any available coupons for the user and email alex@example.com a summary confirming the flight booking, hotel archive, purchase, invoice, and coupon retrieval.

user_input.query: Please check whether flight AA100 is on time, and if it is, book it for Alex Johnson in economy. Then get the stay details for Hilton Tokyo and archive them under the title “Upcoming stay archive.” After that, find a travel_accessories recommendation related to the Sony XM5 item with product ID p_sony_xm5_blk, pick a suitable alternative, place quantity 1 on hold, confirm the order, and add it to the cart items. Next, generate an invoice using coupon code SAVE15 and send it to alex@example.com using paypal as both the payment method and payment gateway. Also retrieve any available coupons for user_123. Finally, send an email summary to alex@example.com and the recipients list alex@example.com confirming the flight booking, hotel archive, purchase, invoice, and coupon retrieval. Priority is medium and channel is email.
